actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 is the exact rejected full-resolution generated PNG editing target. Image2 is the unchanged original small card, sole authority for actual head angle, hair, clothes, crop and lighting. Image3 supplies user mascot identity and compact near-round anatomy only.
Correct ONLY the pointed lower yellow face/neck funnel at the white shirt opening. The yellow lower contour currently descends diagonally into a sharp point below the mouth. Remove this elongated pointed segment and finish ONE COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin close below the closed mouth, immediately contacting a RAISED and BROADENED existing shirt neckline. Keep throat exposure minimal, a very short broad transition, no separate yellow neck shaft, V funnel, pinched narrow human collar, neck rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Broaden the collar and raise its front/rear edges coherently around the rounded head base, with correct cloth overlap and contact shadows. Do not copy the human source long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy. Keep the original actual mild IMAGE-LEFT angle and head roll; do not rotate into a frontal pose to conceal the issue.
Preserve already correct exact source appearance: BAREHEADED short WHITE/SILVER/GREY neatly combed-back hair with receding forehead and real grey/dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. DARK NAVY OPEN naval coat, actual GOLD LEAF lapel decoration and source-exposed gold shoulder area, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK BLACK/GREY necktie. No cap, spectacles, moustache/beard, invented neck pendant or hidden medal rows. Preserve primary near-frontal/mild angle/head roll, grey light and note-limited crop; tiny decorations indefinite. Keep full tilted frame, OPAQUE grey photographic backing and complete lower-right cream note overlap. No new neck pendant, hidden medals, facial hair, readable text or watermark. Genuine alpha only outside the entire framed card. All original internal surfaces remain opaque.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
